name: detect_shots
description: Detect shot boundaries in a video from ffmpeg scene scores, with per-shot motion statistics. Pure ffmpeg — no model or credentials required. The unit of the B-roll footage index.

output.description: {input, duration, shots:[{index, start, end, duration, motion_mean, motion_peak}]}

params.name: threshold
params.description: Scene score above which a frame starts a new shot. Lower finds more cuts.

params.name: min-shot
params.description: Minimum shot duration in seconds. Boundaries that would create a shorter shot are dropped.

params.name: out
params.description: Write JSON here instead of stdout
